source_basis: Not-only-but-also dual-harm opener establishes urgency

interpretation: Dear [Client]...We are pleased to present...reduced by [X]%...Compared to other organizations, [client] has a better combined profile in four areas. Yours sincerely. Professional memo template for F-type papers.

source_basis: Call-to-action closer: "We call on all [stakeholders] who [care about X] to work together"
interpretation: Emotional appeal closing. Unusual for technical papers but appropriate for F-type policy focus. Pattern: imperative + inclusive language + grand cause.

source_basis: SIRS compartmental model adapted for consumer behavior (OPN)
interpretation: Three-compartment ODE system (O/P/N) with mass-action transitions. Novel application of epidemiological framework to wildlife trade demand. Four parameters fitted from WWF survey data. Handoff: P(t) feeds demand factor mu(t) to SPW model.
applicability: Reusable pattern for F-type MCM papers dealing with policy analysis and multi-model frameworks.

source_basis: Modified Lotka-Volterra for poaching-enforcement dynamics (SPW)
interpretation: Two-variable ODE system with demand coupling from OPN. Predator = enforcement resources, prey = poaching volume. Coupling through mu(t) = k*P(t)/S links demand to poaching. Creative cross-domain application.
applicability: Reusable pattern for F-type MCM papers dealing with policy analysis and multi-model frameworks.

source_basis: Difference equation with logistic government strike factor (FIWT)
interpretation: Monthly trade volume = remainder + new poaching - sales - seizures. Government strike factor follows logistic curve: f_t = fm/(1+(fm/f0-1)*exp(-r(t-t0))). Realistic enforcement ramp-up modeling.
applicability: Reusable pattern for F-type MCM papers dealing with policy analysis and multi-model frameworks.

source_basis: Population model with linearly increasing growth rate (FWP)
interpretation: A(t) = A_0*(1+rho_0+sigma*t)^t corrected for poaching and legal hunting. Growth rate increases linearly with ecosystem effort. Integrates all sub-model outputs for final population projection.
applicability: Reusable pattern for F-type MCM papers dealing with policy analysis and multi-model frameworks.

source_basis: AHP-EWM game-theory combined weighting for MCDM
interpretation: Combines subjective AHP (expert judgment) and objective EWM (entropy weights) via game-theory optimization. Consistency check CR=0.068<0.1. TOPSIS scoring produces composite client ranking.
applicability: Reusable pattern for F-type MCM papers dealing with policy analysis and multi-model frameworks.

source_basis: Industrial-chain decomposition: source -> transport -> sale -> population
interpretation: SIWT model structure follows illegal wildlife trade supply chain. Each link gets its own sub-model and strategy. Logical decomposition enables targeted interventions at each stage.
applicability: Reusable pattern for F-type MCM papers dealing with policy analysis and multi-model frameworks.

source_basis: Sub-model coupling forms directed acyclic graph
interpretation: OPN -> SPW (via mu(t)), SPW -> FIWT (via W(t)*C), FIWT -> FWP, OPN -> FWP (via K(t)). Linear dependency chain with one cross-link. Clean handoff structure enables sequential simulation.
applicability: Reusable pattern for F-type MCM papers dealing with policy analysis and multi-model frameworks.
